```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```

```{r}
tumors<- read_csv("~/Desktop/Classes/STAT Gen/data11tumors2.csv")
```


```{r}
tumors <- tumors %>%
  mutate(Class = factor(Class, ordered = FALSE))
```



```{r}
set.seed(123)
tumor_split <- initial_split(tumors, prop = 0.8, strata = Class)
tumor_train <- training(tumor_split)
tumor_test <- testing(tumor_split)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rsample)

# Add set labels
tumor_train$set <- "Train"
tumor_test$set <- "Test"

# Combine for plotting
tumor_split_df <- bind_rows(tumor_train, tumor_test)

# Plot counts
ggplot(tumor_split_df, aes(x = set, fill = Class)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Train-Test Split by Class",
       x = "Dataset",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Tumor Class") +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
tumor_folds <- vfold_cv(tumor_train, v = 5, strata = Class)

```

```{r}
# Add row number as observation ID BEFORE splitting
tumors <- tumors %>%
  mutate(obs_id = row_number())

# Then split into training and test
set.seed(123)
tumor_split <- initial_split(tumors, prop = 0.8, strata = Class)
tumor_train <- training(tumor_split)
tumor_test <- testing(tumor_split)

# Now create folds from tumor_train (which has obs_id!)
tumor_folds <- vfold_cv(tumor_train, v = 5, strata = Class)

```


```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Add observation IDs to the data
tumor_train <- tumor_train %>%
  mutate(obs_id = row_number())

# Extract test (assessment) rows from each fold
fold_vis <- map2_dfr(
  .x = tumor_folds$splits,
  .y = tumor_folds$id,
  .f = ~ {
    assessment(.x) %>%
      mutate(fold = .y) %>%
      select(obs_id, fold)
  }
)


# ✅ FIX this line:
plot_df <- expand.grid(
  obs_id = tumor_train$obs_id,
  fold = unique(fold_vis$fold)
) %>%
  left_join(fold_vis, by = c("obs_id", "fold")) %>%
  mutate(set = ifelse(is.na(fold), "Train", "Test"))  # ✔️ Correct version

# Plot
ggplot(fold_vis, aes(x = fold, y = obs_id, fill = fold)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "5-Fold Cross-Validation: Test Observations per Fold",
    x = "Fold",
    y = "Observation ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")  # optional: remove legend if fold already shown on x-axis


```

```{r}
lasso_spec <- multinom_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = 1  # pure LASSO
) %>%
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

```


```{r}
lasso_rec <- recipe(Class ~ ., data = tumor_train) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

```

```{r}
lasso_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(lasso_rec) %>%
  add_model(lasso_spec)

```

```{r}
penalty_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-4, 1)),  # 10^-4 to 10^1
  levels = 10
)

```




```{r}
tune_output <- tune_grid(
  lasso_wf,
  resamples = tumor_folds,
  grid = penalty_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, mn_log_loss),
  control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

```

```{r}
autoplot(tune_output) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_math(10^.x)) +
  labs(
    x = "λ (Regularization Strength)",
    y = "Performance Metric",
    title = "LASSO Model Performance Across λ Values"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```


```{r}
best_se_penalty <- select_by_one_std_err(
  tune_output,
  metric = "accuracy",
  desc(penalty)
)

```


```{r}
tumors$Class <- as.factor(tumors$Class)

# Create model matrix (X) and response (y)
x <- model.matrix(Class ~ ., data = tumors)[, -1]  # remove intercept
y <- tumors$Class

# Fit LASSO multinomial model
lasso_fit <- glmnet(x, y, family = "multinomial", alpha = 1)

# Plot coefficient paths
plot(lasso_fit, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
```


```{r}
final_lasso_wf <- finalize_workflow(lasso_wf, best_se_penalty)

final_fit <- final_lasso_wf %>%
  fit(data = tumor_train)

```
```{r}
library(broom)

# Tidy the model coefficients
final_fit %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(estimate == 0)

```

```{r}
library(broom)

# Tidy the model coefficients
final_fit %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(estimate != 0)

```



```{r}
conf_mat(preds, truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  summary()

```
## Viz

```{r}
preds <- predict(final_fit, new_data = tumor_test) %>%
  bind_cols(tumor_test)

preds %>%
  metrics(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

preds %>%
  conf_mat(truth = Class, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  theme_minimal()

```
